name: csv-attachment-converted-to-orders-xml
description: The Mule IT's email (one attachment named 'report', application/octet-stream, content src/main/resources/input.csv) is read from the mailbox and removed from it; the attachment is mapped CSV -> XML by 'Map CSV to XML' (values kept as text, e.g. units 2.0) and written to orders.xml. The IT asserts that exactly one output file appears; the XML content follows the DataWeave script and the orders.xsd shipped with the IT.

source.reference: importing-an-email-attachment-using-the-IMAP-connector/src/test/java/org/mule/examples/ImportingAnEmailAttachmentUsingTheIMAPConnectorIT.java#recieveImapMessage (email built in prepareTest) and src/main/app/imap-to-xml.xml (attachments-list, set-payload #[payload[0].getContent()], dw 'Map CSV to XML', file:outbound-endpoint outputPattern="orders.xml"); deletion = Mule 3 mail connector default deleteReadMessages="true"
